verdict.rationale: Relay documents per-card spend limits ([relay-docs-2]) and up to 20 checking accounts for splitting funds by purpose ([relay-docs-1], [relay-docs-25], [relay-docs-14]). Cards can be issued to team members ([relay-docs-16], [relay-docs-26]), so a finance lead could approximate department or program budgets by dedicating accounts and capping card spend. The evidence never describes a native budget object for departments or programs, nor limits enforced automatically at that level, so this is a workaround rather than a budgeting feature. Missing for 10: native department/program budget objects, automatic enforcement of spend at the budget level rather than per card, documentation of budget alerts or controls, and independent corroboration of the workflow.
